profile.bio: Teacher, amateur climber, will talk your ear off about podcasts.

prompts.prompt: I get way too excited about

messages.body: hey Sam! your climbing photo at the gunks is amazing, how long have you been climbing?
about three years! mostly bouldering though
oh nice, I'm a boulderer too. I started during lockdown when my gym reopened and honestly it saved my sanity. what's your favorite problem you've ever sent?
there's a v4 at brooklyn boulders I worked on for a month, so satisfying

a month on one problem is real dedication. I have this one overhang at my gym that I've been failing on for weeks, every time I get to the last move my forearms just give out and I end up dangling like a sad sloth. I've started watching beta videos at night which is probably a sign of a problem. do you watch beta videos or are you a figure-it-out-yourself person?
haha figure it out mostly

that's so much more respectable. ok also I saw your prompt about the podcast, which episodes would you recommend for someone who's never listened? I'm always looking for new ones for my commute, right now I'm rotating between three history podcasts and a cooking one that I listen to even though I can't cook
the one about the shipwreck is good

adding it now! I listened to a great one about the history of salt last week, it was weirdly gripping. I think you'd like it because you seem like someone who likes niche stuff (in a good way!). there's also a whole series on lighthouses I could send you
sure

ok sending it! also how was your weekend? did you get out to climb? I went to the outdoor crag near my sister's place and it was freezing but worth it, I brought a thermos of cocoa and felt very wholesome
it was ok, pretty busy
busy in a good way or a stressful way? I hope it wasn't too much
just work stuff

ugh work weekends are the worst. I used to grade papers all Sunday when I started teaching and it made me feel like I never had a break. what do you do for work again? I think I remember you said something with design?
product design yeah

that's so cool, I've always wondered how product designers decide what goes where. is it a lot of user research or more intuition? I imagine there's a lot of arguing with engineers lol. sorry I'm asking a million questions, I just find it interesting
some of both
makes sense. hey, I hope I'm not overwhelming you with messages haha
no you're fine
ok good. I was thinking it might be fun to climb together sometime? no pressure at all, totally fine if you're busy
maybe, work is crazy right now
totally understand! whenever things calm down. I'm around most evenings after 6 and weekends are pretty open
ok
also I found that shipwreck episode and loved it, the part about the captain's diary was wild
glad you liked it
I listened to two more from that series on my run this morning. do you have a favorite episode of theirs?
not really
fair! ok I'll stop bugging you, have a good night
night
good morning! hope work is a little calmer today
thanks
did you end up getting any climbing in this week?
nope

preferences: Not sure yet. Maybe something slow and low-pressure.

profile.bio: Recently moved back to the city. Coffee snob, slow runner.

messages.body: hi! your profile says coffee snob, so I have to ask: what's the best coffee in the city?

denver, I was there for six years. came back to be closer to family
that's a big move. how's the adjustment going?
mostly good! some days it feels like home, some days it feels like I'm visiting someone else's life
that's a really honest way to put it
I've had a lot of time to think on long runs lol
how far do you run?
slowly and not far, but consistently. I'm training for a 10k in the spring
that's awesome. I do a saturday run club if you ever want company

there's a slow group, very chatty, mostly an excuse for brunch after
brunch run club is the dream
so would you want to come this saturday?
maybe! I'll see how my week goes. what else do you do on weekends?
usually farmers market, sometimes hiking. you?
lately just settling into the apartment, I still have boxes everywhere
I could help you carry boxes, I'm very strong (I am not)
haha I appreciate the confidence
ok real question: would you want to get that cardamom coffee together sometime?
that would be nice. things are a little up in the air for me right now though
no rush at all. what's up in the air if you don't mind me asking?
just a lot of change at once. I'm not sure I'm totally ready for things to move fast, but I like talking to you
that's completely fair. we can keep it slow
thank you, that means a lot
so how was your run today?
good! I did 5k without stopping for the first time
that's huge!! congrats
thanks!! I celebrated with an oat flat white in your honor
honored. maybe next time we celebrate together
haha maybe. how was your day?
good, long meeting day. what are you up to tonight?
unpacking more boxes probably

I play pickup soccer badly and cook pasta well

cacio e pepe. it took me like 40 tries to stop it clumping

pigeons are just doves that moved to the city and got jaded

mostly indie stuff, some jazz when I'm cooking
jazz and pasta is a whole vibe

I make a decent curry, nothing fancy

green curry, my grandma's recipe

well, maybe I could make you cacio e pepe and you could judge it

how about next friday? I'll try not to burn the apartment down

state, then grad school in boston. you?

sometimes. what's your favorite place you've been?
lisbon, by far. have you been?
no. what did you like about it?
the food, the light, the tiles everywhere. what's your dream trip?
not sure. how long were you there?
two weeks. you don't talk about yourself much huh

an 1890s map of the city where half the streets don't exist anymore

yeah, from estate sales mostly. I spend too many saturdays at them
that's such a specific hobby, I love it

farmers market and lazy cooking. maybe you could show me the map wall sometime
maybe. what do you usually cook?
a lot of soups. you didn't answer about the map wall haha
sorry, yes, that would be nice. maybe coffee first?
coffee first sounds perfect
how about sunday morning?
sunday works, 10am?
see you then
looking forward to it
